notes.title: August Dev Update - First look at draft, public demo and how to get involved
notes.content: [p]Hey all! [/p][p][/p][p]Firstly, apologies for the silence over the last few months. The team have been heads down developing and ensuring we make the best game possible (it's coming along amazingly!!).[/p][previewyoutube="03jyuqJ5k1Q;full"][/previewyoutube][p]This month we did our first dev update in a video format 🥳, and you can expect these monthly moving forward. Check out the video above for the rundown or see the summary below:[/p][p][/p][p][b]First look at our draft system[/b] [/p][p]Fitted out with 80+ champions we've handcrafted. We've also made huge improvements to this already in the past three weeks.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559815/2f6b4c6e107b2f743d7a393ffd0bd92880626f7d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Details about our first public demo[/b][/p][p]Right now, we've only demoed internally with a select focus group, but we're excited to announce we'll be part of Steam's Next Fest event from October 13th to October 20th, so mark your calendars as that'll be the first time you get to dive into our demo. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559815/68299e731b21cec420385eda16a61533bd48b811.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]How you can be part of Esports Team Manager[/b][/p][p]Are you a MOBA player, coach, analyst, creator, streamer, or own a team invested in a relevant title? Get in touch with us on our relevant social channels or Discord linked below - we'd love to hear from you![/p][p]X/Twitter: [url="https://x.com/esportstmgame/status/1962950740466385303"]https://x.com/esportstmgame/status/1962950740466385303[/url][/p][p]Instagram: [url="https://www.instagram.com/esportsteammanager"]https://www.instagram.com/esportsteammanager[/url][/p][p]Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/QkMEu8ED4e"]https://discord.gg/QkMEu8ED4e[/url][/p][p][/p][p]That's it for our August dev update - see you next month as we continue to ramp up for a Q4 launch.[/p][p][/p][p]-Nathan, Co-Founder & CMO[/p]

notes.title: Development Update #4 - Summer Push, Real Teams!
notes.content: [p]Happy summer vibes, everyone! It's almost 100F where I'm based (or 40ish C roughly if that applies to you), so we're in the thick of summer! [/p][p][/p][p]Sharing an announcement to let everyone know the team is alive and well, just hard at work through what we're happy to call a more quiet and settled in part of development, we're blessed and lucky you're on this journey with us. [/p][p][/p][p]A bit of a re-introduction, our goal is to be a super realistic esports team manager game with [i]real[/i] teams. We're doing a ton on both fronts:[/p][p][/p][p]The Game: development continues smoothly! As a one-person dev team with supporting artists and team, work continues as you'd expect on a smaller bootstrapped team. I remain fully confident though for our Q4 release, and we're so excited to share more about that soon. I expect we'll be announcing a release date sometime in August or so? Please don't hold me to it  but for Q4 we'll have to know around then! [/p][p][/p][p]The Teams: right now we have roughly [b]EIGHT[/b] teams signed on to be in the game. These are real teams from semi-pro regional League of Legends leagues, and we're so honored to move forward with their partnerships. While these remain unofficial as we sort Legalese and continue to meet with teams to cover scope more broadly, we've got some crazy fun announcement forthcoming.[/p][p][/p][p]Our larger social media pushes will be starting within the next month or two, so hang tight, you're in for a great ride, and we're so excited you're here. If you haven't already, please give the game a wishlist and a follow on Steam, and let your friends know we're here too. And keep enjoying that summer weather as much as you can, go touch grass now so you can be playing this through the holidays comfortably inside![/p][p][/p][p]- Paul, Founder and Lead Dev[/p]

notes.title: Development Update #3 - New Co-Founder, Draft!
notes.content:
Well hi there, everyone! For those of you in the US or elsewhere that had a long weekend, I hope you enjoyed it! I know I sure did - I needed a reset. 

I have a couple fun announcements to share. 

1. Please join me in welcoming Nathan Edmonds as our new Co-founder and Chief Marketing Officer! We're so excited to have his years of experience and expertise to help us reach a global audience as we ramp up our marketing efforts into and through the fall. Welcome Nathan!!

2. From a dev side - we're hard at work and remain on track. Our early internal playtests have been incredible to keep "finding the fun" wherever we can, which has added changes including a full pro style draft system, patch/meta shifts, tons of in-game "champs" or "heroes," and much more. I can't wait to share it all with you soon. 

And that's it! My goal for these is to continue to let you know hey, we're here, we're hard at work. More visuals to come as our incredible art and graphics team finishes their parts, but for now you'll have to settle for a text preview of what's in my code :) 

Enjoy your week, and make sure you keep telling your friends - ETM is coming in Q4!

notes.title: Development Update #2
notes.content:
Hi, Steam folks! :D

Now's as good a time as any to let people know some baseline fun facts about Esports Team Manager! 

[olist]
[*] NO MICROTRANSACTIONS. Plain, simple, and never. The only "extra" will likely be a donation tier for people who want to donate to the team and have their name added into the game, but I wouldn't consider that a microtransaction. We're keeping these at arms length.
[*] Cheaper than most skins in most games. That's right. We're coming into Early Access at $20, with a sale price of $16 (all based on USD).
[*] Real teams. We've already had 4 teams agree to be in the game, and we're looking to expand to about 20 by the time the fall rolls around. While I can't guarantee or predict that aspect, I remain confident we'll have at minimum a nice plethora of real AND thoughtfully constructed fictitious teams.
[/olist]

Also please join me in welcoming Cubby to the development team! Cubby serves as our Lead Ratings Analyst - who better to rate our players and teams than someone who's coached, commentated, and watched all of these players and teams regularly? We're honored to have his expertise and guidance throughout this process. 

That's all for today! Please keep spreading the word! If you haven't joined our Discord, please consider doing so for regular updates and to reach out to me directly if you have any questions about the game. 

Until next time - lots of love!

- Paul Capoccia
CEO + Lead Dev at The Brain Trust, the minds behind Esports Team Manager

notes.title: Development Update #1
notes.content:
Thank you all so much for a successful Steam Store Page Launch. We are so grateful for all of the love and support, all of the wishlists, the Discord server joins, and so much more. 

So we're on Steam - what's next? 

First, we're working on and continuing our internal friends & family playtesting rounds as we are in the full throes of a mad dash towards Early Access launch in the fall. This summer, we hope to open up playtesting through Steam to finalize our beta ahead of launch. Please wishlist and stick around for more information there. 

While all of that is going on, we're continuing to add real teams into the game. To date, we have at least four that have verbally agreed to be in the game; at this point, we're just finalizing some paperwork before beginning a full onboarding sweep. Our hope is to have at least 10+ real teams in the game by our Early Access launch. 

Last but not least for this update, we're lucky to have an incredible staff. We're up to a full staff of six including myself, and we're so honored and privileged to be bringing you a game we so deeply care about. 

Buckle up for a wonderful ride, we hope you'll be part of it. If you haven't wishlisted, followed, or joined our Discord yet, please consider it, and stay tuned for our next update. My plan is to push our dev updates every two weeks unless we pass a milestone worthy of its own update. 

Thanks so much - stick around! 

- Paul Capoccia
CEO + Lead Dev at The Brain Trust, the minds behind Esports Team Manager
